capabilities.label: Live Target Action
capabilities.operatorIntent: Observe an explicitly authorized target without modifying it.
capabilities.nextPromotion: Improve operator UX and audit summaries before adding broader target actions.

capabilities.label: Network Access
capabilities.operatorIntent: Perform DNS, TLS metadata, or HTTP HEAD read-only checks under policy.
capabilities.nextPromotion: Add batch live-readonly audit summaries and target allowlist review.

capabilities.label: Secret Exposure & Credential Posture
capabilities.operatorIntent: Extract, classify, hash, redact, and report in-scope secret exposures from authorized evidence so operators can rotate and harden without using the credential material.
capabilities.nextPromotion: Implement authorized secret exposure extraction from supplied or in-scope evidence, with hashing, redaction, severity, owner routing, and rotation guidance.

capabilities.label: Payload Delivery
capabilities.operatorIntent: Model payload/control validation plans and ingest synthetic or supplied results.
capabilities.nextPromotion: Implement payload simulation planning and synthetic result ingestion only.

capabilities.label: Mutation
capabilities.operatorIntent: Generate remediation proposals, diffs, rollback plans, and reassessment plans before any write.
capabilities.nextPromotion: Implement D5 proposal-only remediation plan generation.

capabilities.label: Destructive Behavior
capabilities.operatorIntent: Model blast radius and rollback readiness without destructive execution.
capabilities.nextPromotion: Implement tabletop and blast-radius modeling only.

nonClaims: Blocked capabilities are not executable through this catalog.
Secret exposure extraction is for authorized hardening and rotation workflows, not credential material use or disclosure.
Mutation, payload delivery, and destructive behavior require separate future gated programs.
